query:
UPDATE accounts SET
            account_number   = $2,
            account_name     = $3,
            firstname        = $4,
            lastname         = $5,
            othername        = $6,
            bank_name        = $7,
            bvn              = $8,
            nin              = $9,
            nin_userid       = $10,
            phone_number     = $11,
            address          = $12,
            date_of_birth    = $13,
            gender           = $14,
            current_tier=1,
            tier_upgraded_at=  NOW(),
            updated_at       = NOW()
        WHERE id = $1
